findings.title: The Reorder this week card shows stock but not the reorder decision

location.description: the Reorder this week card with its table of Title, On shelf and Sold this week

findings.viewer_experience: The headline and subhead promise that Shelfmark tells you which titles to reorder. The owner sees two columns of numbers and has to work out the decision alone. Nothing says how this is better than the till report they already have.

current.value: three columns: Title, On shelf, Sold this week; no decision column and no comparison line

findings.target: a column that states the decision for each title, and one short line that compares Shelfmark with how a shop works now
findings.fix_direction: Add a column that states the decision for each title, and one short line that compares Shelfmark with how a shop works now. The maker must supply the column label, its values, and what the comparison says.

closed_when.check: in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the card has a column that states the reorder decision for each title and one short line that compares Shelfmark with how a shop works now

findings.title: The note Works with your till names no till

location.description: the first of the three notes under the hero, Works with your till

findings.viewer_experience: An owner cannot tell whether their till is supported.
findings.target: the note names the tills Shelfmark works with
findings.fix_direction: Name the tills Shelfmark works with. The maker must supply the list of tills.

closed_when.check: in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the first note names at least one till

findings.title: The three notes under the hero have unequal widths and line up with nothing above

location.description: the row of three notes under the hero

findings.viewer_experience: The third note lines up with nothing above it, and on desktop the middle note still wraps to three lines.

current.value: 406/325/325 px on desktop and 425/340/340 px on widescreen

findings.target: three equal columns, or notes 2 and 3 on the card's column lines (x 537 and 841 or 1001 on desktop)
findings.fix_direction: Make the three columns equal, or put notes 2 and 3 on the card's column lines (x 537 and 841 or 1001 on desktop).

closed_when.check: the box widths of section.facts > p:nth-of-type(1), (2) and (3) in the desktop and widescreen viewports are equal, or the left edges of notes 2 and 3 match the card's column left_edges
